The Role

Block is seeking an Internal Audit Senior Manager - Regulatory Compliance. This role is responsible for partnering with the Head of Internal Audit, internal and external resources, and stakeholders. The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing and executing against the Internal Audit plan, focusing on regulatory compliance audits and validation work covering U. S. payment and banking regulations. This role will also help develop longer term strategies for Block's Internal Audit team, including conducting robust risk assessments, supporting emerging regulatory compliance requirements, and developing talent within the team.

The ideal candidate will have exceptional project management and organizational skills including the ability to successfully interact with all levels of the organization, senior management. Superior analytical skills and strong business acumen are also critical success factors. The ideal candidate possesses fin-tech experience, with deep knowledge of payments regulatory requirements and expectations along with proficient experience with audit planning, executing, and reporting responsibilities. Additionally, the candidate will manage and effectively collaborate with Internal Audit's external partners (external auditors, outsourcing partners, process and control owners) who assist us with executing the internal audit plan.

You Will

  • Lead and execute regulatory compliance audits covering financial crime (AML/BSA) and consumer protection laws and regulations.
  • Manage essential aspects of the regulatory compliance audit strategy, and effectively represent the Internal Audit team by providing strategic direction and expertise in the regulatory compliance audit approach and execution.
  • Be proficiently knowledgeable in payments compliance for regulatory requirements and expectations across various systems, environments, and business units.
  • Build governance and risk management processes through conducting risk assessments, driving delivery of the Internal Audit plan in accordance with established methodology, procedures, and documentations.
  • Oversee and manage external consultant relationships as needed based on the staff resourcing requirements of any audit project.
  • Develop and promote collaborative relationships with internal and external partners (external auditors, outsourced partners, process and control owners).
  • Proactively anticipate business partner needs and opportunities for involvement.
  • Manage special audit projects in an ad-hoc manner.

You Have

  • 10+ years in audit execution across operational, compliance and regulatory audits including technology audits, and experience managing teams in a well-disciplined organization where best practices are integral to the management of the business.
  • A BA/BS degree in Accounting, Finance or related field required; Big 4 firm experience highly preferred.
  • Experience in a Fintech Internal Audit organization and strong knowledge of U. S. payments and banking laws and regulations, specifically FinCEN, CFPB, and FDIC.
  • Experience with AML/CFT audits, technical accounting, SOX/audit methodologies, and risk management responsibilities within a complex, technology, financial services, and regulated business.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, including outstanding ability to summarize complex issues into succinct communication for a wide range of internal and external executive constituents.

About Us

Fortitude, backed by DCG, is an institutional-scale, vertically integrated venture mining platform operating across the Proof-of-Work ecosystem and anchored in Zcash. The Company pairs self-mining operations with an owned data center footprint, a diversified power portfolio backed by competitive long-term contracts, and disciplined capital allocation to identify and scale high-conviction opportunities in emerging Proof-of-Work protocols, beginning with its leadership position in the Zcash network.

Fortitude is led by an experienced team of operators, capital markets professionals, and digital asset specialists with a track record of identifying and scaling high-conviction opportunities and building privacy-preserving digital asset infrastructure.

 

About the Role

We are hiring a Project Coordinator to support keeping our construction and facilities projects on schedule, on budget, and well documented. You will work alongside project managers, site supervisors, engineers, and outside contractors, acting as the central point for schedules, paperwork, and day-to-day communication. Success in this role means projects move without avoidable delays, and everyone has the information they need when they need it.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support project managers in building and maintaining project schedules, tracking milestones, deliverables, and dependencies across multiple active sites
  • Support project managers and work with the site operations team, as applicable, to coordinate subcontractors, vendors, and suppliers across existing and greenfield sites, including scheduling, deliveries, and site access
  • Prepare, track, and file project documentation: proposals, contracts, equipment spec sheets, drawings, invoices, RFIs, submittals, change orders, meeting minutes, and punch lists, using a filing system for easy access
  • Support budget tracking by logging invoices, purchase orders, and cost changes, and flagging variances to the project manager
  • Assist with permit applications, inspection scheduling, and regulatory compliance records
  • Collect and organize safety documentation, including toolbox talks, incident reports, and contractor insurance and licensing
  • Run weekly coordination meetings and follow up on open action items
  • Produce regular status reports for project managers and leadership
  • Maintain equipment, materials, and procurement logs, and help expedite long-lead items
  • Support project closeout, including as-builts, warranties, and handover packages
  • Generate Master Service Agreements using legal templates, with the associated scope of work, drawings, spec sheets, and estimates; route them through legal for final approval and execution
  • Onboard vendors and contractors for accounts payable, insurance, and compliance

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience coordinating projects in construction, facilities, or a related field
  • Associate or bachelor's degree in construction management, engineering, business, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
  • Working knowledge of project scheduling and tracking tools (e.g., MS Project, Procore, Smartsheet) and Microsoft Office or Google Workspace
  • Familiarity with construction documents, drawings, and common terms such as RFIs, submittals, and change orders
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines
  • Clear written and verbal communication with contractors, vendors, and executives

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with cryptocurrency mining or similar high-density data center facilities is a plus. Relevant background includes:

  • Coordinating build-outs or expansions of mining or hosting sites, including container, warehouse, or modular deployments
  • Working with electrical contractors and utilities on high-load power, switchgear, transformers, and interconnection timelines
  • Managing cooling and airflow projects (air, hydro, or immersion) and related infrastructure
  • Understanding of site-selection factors such as power availability, zoning, noise ordinances, and environmental permitting

Working Conditions

This is a remote position with occasional travel to project sites as needed Preferred location is in Nebraska. Expect to:

  • Work remotely with reliable internet and be reachable during core business hours
  • Wear required PPE (hard hat, safety glasses, steel-toe boots, high-visibility vest) during site visits
  • Lift up to 25 lbs and stand or walk for extended periods during site visits, including uneven ground, stairs, and noisy or dusty areas
  • Travel occasionally to existing and greenfield sites as needed
  • Be available on short notice when schedule-critical issues arise

WHAT WE OFFER: 

  • The chance to work in a fast-paced and fun start-up environment with experienced industry leaders 
  • A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact 
  • Competitive base salary, bonus and incentive compensation  
  • Discretionary time off - work with your manager to take time off when you need it 
  • Professional development budget with flexibility for personal and professional growth 
  • Outstanding health insurance for employee, partner and dependents

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Custom objects allow businesses to define custom data models in Stripe, ensuring Stripe reflects how their business operates. A business might have data that doesn’t fit standard Stripe objects, such as Shipments, Reservations, or InsurancePolicies. Once defined in Stripe, that custom data can be used with Stripe-native objects, such as Customers, Subscriptions, and Invoices. Companies can keep their existing system of record and bring over what their Stripe integration needs, or use custom objects as the system of record for that data.

Custom objects are the data pillar of Stripe’s extensibility platform, which consists of Stripe Apps, Stripe Workflows, scripts, and extension points.

We’re hiring a product manager to lead our custom objects product, which will make it easy for anyone to model, ingest, and use data on Stripe.

What you’ll do

This is a product management opportunity for an early-stage product (private preview!), and you’ll be responsible for the entire product line: identifying use cases, product design, iterating quickly by partnering with early adopters, pricing, and more. You’ll also work very closely with multiple teams at Stripe to enable their products to be “custom object-ready.”

Responsibilities

  • Interact with customers and internal product teams daily so that you can validate product ideas, requirements, and prototypes
  • Partner with engineering and design to ship functionality that delights users, strikes the right balance between impact and engineering cost, and makes a measurable impact
  • Develop the vision, strategy, and roadmap so that we can launch in public preview in early 2027
  • Define key success metrics
  • Work closely with user researchers to test hypotheses and understand user pain points

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 12+ years of product management experience
  • A computer science background or equivalent technical experience
  • Both passion for and experience building data platforms. For example, you’ve either built a custom data platform, such as Salesforce Custom Objects, Shopify Metaobjects, or HubSpot Custom Objects, or you’ve built a tool that consumes or modifies objects from those platforms.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to structure ambiguous concepts clearly and from first principles, and the ability to thrive in a collaborative environment involving different functions, stakeholders, and subject matter experts
  • Demonstrated experience leading initiatives across large engineering organizations, spanning multiple teams to influence technical roadmap planning and execution

Preferred qualifications

  • You enjoy using social media to interact directly with customers for feedback
  • You’ve founded a business or startup, taking a product from zero to one
  • You only ship functionality after you’ve personally test-driven it and made heavy edits to the documentation

Senior Supplier Quality Engineer

As a Senior Supplier Quality Engineer, you will own purchased parts from sourcing award through steady-state production as we build our vehicles and the factory to produce them at volume. You will work closely with Procurement, Design Engineering, and Manufacturing to qualify and launch new suppliers so parts are ready before the line needs them. From there, you will keep those suppliers in control by catching problems at the source, driving root cause and corrective action, and raising supplier capability. As an early employee at a fast-moving startup, you will help shape how Parallel builds and manages its supply base. 

Responsibilities

  • Assess and qualify new suppliers with Procurement, covering capability, quality system, capacity, and operational and financial risk
  • Run APQP with each supplier, including timing plans, design and process FMEAs, control plans and gated readiness reviews
  • Drive PPAP (or FAI to AS9102 where applicable) to approval by reviewing submissions, witnessing first-article builds and dispositioning gaps
  • Lead run-at-rate and capacity verification at supplier sites to prove they can meet the production ramp
  • Track tooling, gauge and fixture build and buy-off, and confirm tooling ownership and identification
  • Feed supplier design-for-manufacturing and tolerance feedback to Design Engineering before release
  • Maintain a part-level readiness tracker and report status and risk at program build gates
  • Own supplier quality performance for an assigned commodity portfolio (e.g., machined and fabricated structures, castings, electrical harnesses, battery and power electronics, motors and drivetrain)
  • Lead the response to nonconforming material, including containment, MRB disposition, 8D / root cause and verification that corrective actions work
  • Issue and manage Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs) and drive them to closure on time
  • Run supplier process and quality-system audits on site and close out findings
  • Define incoming inspection plans, sampling levels and acceptance criteria with receiving inspection
  • Track and report supplier scorecards (PPM, SCAR cycle time, cost of poor quality) and escalate at-risk suppliers
  • Approve supplier change requests (process, material, site, sub-tier) and require re-validation where needed
  • Lead supplier development projects to improve process capability (Cpk), error-proofing and control plans

  • After 30 Days: You’ve reviewed every open part, taken over the readiness tracker, and learned our process for nonconforming parts and SCARs. Your tracker covers every assigned part, and you’ve visited 3–5 critical suppliers.

  • After 90 Days: Your first PPAP approvals have landed in time for the next build gate, and at least one critical supplier has proven it can build at rate. A monthly scorecard is running, and no parts in your portfolio have stopped the line.

  • 5+ years of experience in supplier quality, supplier development or new-product introduction in automotive, rail, aerospace, heavy equipment or a similar regulated industry
  • Hands-on experience running APQP and approving PPAP or FAI packages
  • Experience with structured problem solving, including 8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa and fault-tree analysis
  • Working knowledge of PFMEA, control plans, MSA, SPC and process capability studies
  • Proficient in reading engineering drawings and GD&T and judging manufacturability
  • Experience leading supplier audits against ISO 9001 or IATF 16949
  • Strong program management skills, including timing plans, risk tracking and cross-functional reviews
  • Willing to travel to supplier sites roughly 30–50% of the time, with heavier travel during launches

Preferred Qualifications:

The role will lead end-to-end validation of fraud models, from conceptual soundness, data and implementation review to outcomes analysis, performance monitoring, and remediation follow-up.   • Establish and own the independent validation framework for fraud models and AI-enabled decision systems across OKX products, covering conceptual soundness, data quality, implementation, and outcomes analysis, in line with SR 26-2 and equivalent model risk frameworks.

  • Personally execute end-to-end model validations as the technical expert, including independently reproducing results through hands-on data analysis and code review.
  • Assess AI/ML and generative AI applications, including LLM-based and agentic systems, for robustness, reliability, explainability, and appropriate human oversight, applying strong applied AI evaluation expertise.
  • Perform ongoing monitoring review and periodic revalidation to ensure sustained model performance through changing fraud patterns and business conditions.
  • Provide effective challenge to model owners; communicate conclusions, limitations, and risk ratings clearly to senior management and governance forums, and track remediation through closure.
  • Build and continuously mature the fraud model validation capability, standards, and workflows within MRM.
 

What We Look For In You

  • 10+ years of quantitative, fraud risk, or model risk experience, with a recognized track record as a hands-on technical expert who personally delivers independent validations of models and decision systems.

  • Practical experience with statistical and machine learning methods; proficiency in Python and SQL; working knowledge of SR 11-7 or equivalent model risk and AI governance frameworks.
  • Experience with AI/ML governance and controls, including explainability, fairness, robustness, ongoing monitoring, or generative and agentic AI applications in fraud operations.
 

Nice to Haves

  • Experience establishing validation frameworks, methodologies, or capabilities in settings where they did not previously exist.
  • Strong applied AI capability: hands-on experience evaluating or building ML/LLM-based systems in production, including prompt engineering, evaluation harnesses, fine-tuning assessment, or agentic AI workflows; able to run red-team style testing on AI applications.

Supportability sits at the vital intersection of platform safety, regulatory trust and merchant growth. Our mission is to ensure legitimate businesses can seamlessly onboard and thrive on Stripe, while proactively safeguarding the financial ecosystem from bad actors and high-risk activity.

The Supportability Decisions team is a newly forming pillar anchored in our Dublin office. In this role, you will be the foundational technical lead establishing this capability in Dublin. Our mission is to accelerate Stripe’s global expansion by building the canonical Supportability Decision Layer; a stateful distributed platform that provides unified, real-time, and explainable risk determinations to unlock fast, compliant merchant onboarding and payment method expansion worldwide.

Doing this at scale requires solving high-stakes risk challenges with precision. Deceptive merchant activity, such as transaction laundering, introduces significant threats as bad actors actively adapt to mask illicit and unsupported activities behind legitimate storefronts. Rather than relying on rigid, fragmented controls that create unnecessary friction for good users, our team builds the intelligent decision systems that systematically separate legitimate businesses from adversarial behavior, enabling Stripe to grow safely and aggressively.

What you’ll do

As a Staff Backend Engineer and Technical Lead for Supportability Decisions, you will take ownership of defining and building this new space from the ground up. You will build systems that operate at the intersection of AI/ML, distributed data processing and real-time risk decisioning. You will tackle high-ambiguity technical challenges in an adversarial threat landscape, turning broad risk policies and operational needs into resilient, high-throughput backend services and stateful decision engines. As the technical anchor in Dublin, you will set architectural patterns, mentor engineers as the team scales from its initial members to ~7 ICs, and drive technical alignment with distributed partner teams globally.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical vision, system architecture and delivery of the canonical Supportability Decision Layer, establishing stateful, explainable decision APIs consumed across automated systems and human operations.
  • Architect decision aggregation and AI/ML orchestration pipelines, synthesizing upstream machine learning outputs, website intelligence, backsite detection, and agentic AI evaluations into unified, low-latency determinations.
  • Design high-throughput, low-latency distributed backend services that balance platform safety, regulatory compliance, and minimal friction for legitimate merchants.
  • Navigate ambiguous, zero-to-one problem spaces to define clean domain models, contracts and interfaces across transaction laundering detection, web-presence screening and Local Payment Method (LPM) support.
  • Build resilient, AI-assisted decision engines designed to withstand circumvention, ensuring systems maintain integrity against sophisticated bad actors who actively evolve their tactics. 
  • Serve as the technical lead and mentor for the Dublin engineering team, setting architectural patterns, conducting design reviews, and raising the technical bar as the team expands.
  • Partner closely with Engineering Managers, Product Managers, Risk Operations, and Data Science to translate strategic risk policy into scalable technical roadmaps.
  • Drive technical alignment and system integrations across global partner teams, leveraging strong written design artifacts and asynchronous collaboration to ensure cohesive platform architecture.

Who you are

We're looking for a technical leader who thrives in ambiguity, has deep distributed systems instincts, and is energized by building a critical platform that enables global merchant growth while safeguarding the financial ecosystem. If that sounds like you, we encourage you to apply.

  • 10+ years of professional backend software engineering experience building and maintaining complex distributed systems in production.
  • Proven track record as a technical lead or staff engineer driving multi-quarter technical initiatives from ambiguous requirements to production delivery.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Risk team builds trust, an essential ingredient for Stripe’s mission to increase the GDP of the internet. We make it possible for millions of businesses to access and use Stripe’s financial infrastructure while protecting our users, financial partners, and the broader ecosystem from harm.

Risk sits at the center of our users’ and Stripe’s ability to grow safely. We help legitimate businesses access Stripe’s financial services, provide credit to creditworthy businesses, and increasingly help users manage their own risk. We also prevent fraud and financial crime, manage Stripe’s credit exposure, meet our obligations to regulators and financial partners, and enable Stripe’s product teams to launch and grow products safely. To do this, we set the policies and standards that guide how Stripe manages risk and develop the advanced AI, infrastructure, and product experiences that put them into practice for Stripe and our users.

At Stripe’s scale—$1.9 trillion in annual payment volume, equivalent to 1.6% of global GDP, processed across millions of businesses—we face risk problems no other company has encountered. The opportunities and complexities are only growing as AI reshapes what is possible, Stripe expands its product suite, regulators raise their expectations, and we support more businesses in more countries.

What you’ll do

As a Staff Product Manager on the Risk team, you will lead cross-Risk and cross-Stripe initiatives that fundamentally change how Stripe and our users manage risk. You will identify the most important opportunities that cut across Risk’s infrastructure and products, define solutions to our most ambiguous problems, and drive execution from early technical shaping through delivery and adoption.

You will operate as a product counterpart to Risk’s senior technical leaders. You will shape infrastructure and product direction across Risk, connect work that would otherwise remain fragmented, and help product teams across Stripe build on Risk’s capabilities. You will remain deeply engaged in the work, helping teams navigate difficult technical and product decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Identify high-leverage problems that cut across teams, turn ambiguity into clear product and technical direction, and establish measurable outcomes.

  • Lead changes in Risk’s approach to using data and AI to accurately identify and mitigate risk at scale.
  • Partner deeply with engineering, data science, and machine learning leaders to shape architecture, data foundations, models, APIs, and product experiences.
  • Help product teams across Stripe build on Risk’s capabilities quickly and effectively while guiding Risk teams toward coherent, reusable infrastructure and product decisions.

We’re looking for an exceptional product leader who combines strong technical judgment with product insight, strategic range, and executional rigor. You identify important problems before they become obvious, bring clarity to deeply ambiguous spaces, and mobilize teams around solutions that work across products, organizations, and time horizons. You are deeply curious and stay at the forefront of advances in AI and technology, finding practical ways to apply them to our most challenging problems.

You move fluently from defining multi-year strategy to driving the details of execution. You build alignment and lead transformational work across teams without direct management authority. You earn trust through the clarity of your thinking, your focus on users, and your hands-on engagement in the work. You raise the ambition and effectiveness of the teams and product managers around you without needing to manage them.

  • A track record of identifying and delivering high-impact, transformational product or technical initiatives that span multiple teams and organizations.

  • Experience partnering deeply with senior engineering, data science, and product leaders to shape both technical direction and product strategy.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate compelling strategies, influence technical and executive audiences, and make complex topics clear.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience applying AI and machine learning to complex, high-stakes problems at scale.
  • Experience with fraud, credit, payments, financial services, trust and safety, or another domain involving complex decisions and asymmetric consequences.

About Mesh

At Mesh, our mission is to enable consumers to pay and be paid with any asset. Today, trillions of dollars in tokenized assets exist but remain largely unusable for everyday commerce. Mesh is bridging this gap by making crypto payments reliable, useful, and ubiquitous. We combine a powerful orchestration engine with a seamless consumer app to unlock liquidity for the world. Backed by leading investors like SBI, Money Forward, Paradigm, Dragonfly, Galaxy, and PayPal Ventures, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of the global economy. Join us!

Overview

Mesh moves money across exchanges, wallets, banks, card networks and local payment rails. You will own that money: the right liquidity in the right place, partners pre-funded, settlements paid on time, corporate cash invested within policy, and every stuck transfer found and fixed. You also review the money-movement terms of new deals before they are signed, and you build, with Engineering and Product, the automation that tells us where liquidity is needed and moves it there.

What You'll Do

  • Manage daily cash and liquidity across bank accounts, customer fund accounts, custodians and stablecoin wallets, and forecast needs by product and corridor.
  • Run pre-funding and settlement lines with liquidity and payout partners: float levels, top-ups and line usage.
  • Work with Engineering and Product to build automated liquidity management for Mesh from Scratch (MFS), our new platform, from the ground up: real-time views of where liquidity is needed across bank accounts, wallets and partners, and automated deployment and rebalancing either internally or using an external tool. 
  • Review the money-movement terms of new customer and partner deals before signature: pre-funding, settlement timing, float, FX, subsidies and partner costs. Sign-off is required for ramp, OTC and other deals.
  • Track incentive and subsidy spend against approved limits.
  • Fund settlements with bank and partners on their cycles.
  • Work the daily exception queue: stuck or failed transfers, uncredited deposits and settlement breaks, resolved with partners and Engineering and logged with root cause.
  • Handle partner compliance requests such as source-of-funds reviews on large trades.
  • Invest corporate cash under a policy approved by the CEO & CFO.
  • Shape the investment policy and crypto signing matrix with the CFO, then run them along with approval limits and dual controls, and manage bank and custodian relationships.
  • Provide month-end statements and support for bank, investment, custody and restricted cash balances.
  • Maintain a 13-week cash forecast with Strategic Finance

Who You Are

  • 5+ years in treasury or payment operations at a payments company, money transmitter, exchange or stablecoin business.
  • Hands-on experience with both fiat and stablecoin money movement.
  • A deep understanding of the payments and liquidity space, and experience specifying and building automated treasury or liquidity systems with engineering teams.
  • Liquidity and prefunding management with external partners.
  • Experience reviewing settlement and funding terms in commercial contracts.
  • Experience operating under an investment policy and approval controls

  • Latin American payment rails (PIX, SPEI).
